claim: Turns a 1–5 second section of a local video into tracing frames.
sandbox: fresh browser; create a six-second local WebM; prove 1.0 and 5.0 seconds render frames and 0.5 and 5.1 seconds show the recovery message

claim: Try a ready twelve-frame paper-bird sample with one click.
sandbox: fresh 390 px browser at landing; click the named action once; assert ?demo=1, banner, twelve frames, and a visible sample frame

claim: The paper-bird sample regenerates frames for the selected 1–5 second section and frame rate.
sandbox: fresh demo; change 2 seconds at 6 fps to 5 seconds at 12 fps; make frames; assert 12 then 60 generated frames; reset to 12

claim: Demo sample data is not saved and demo mode does not read or change real settings or licenses.
where: demo banner, demo contract, README, and privacy
sandbox: preseed real IndexedDB preferences and license keys before demo navigation; instrument reads and opens; reset demo; start for real; compare all real storage

claim: Exports numbered PNGs as a ZIP pack.
sandbox: demo frames; inspect ZIP signature and final numbered filename

claim: Exports a printable PDF trace sheet.
sandbox: demo frames; independently decode the embedded JPEG page and assert twelve numbered non-blank cells in four columns

claim: Video and frame processing stay in the browser.
sandbox: after the shell settles, import, trace, and export a generated local WebM; reject every HTTP request, including same-origin GET queries, methods, and request bodies

claim: The source video and generated frames stay in page memory and disappear on reload.
sandbox: settle the app-shell baseline; import a generated video with a known byte/pixel sentinel; recursively hash every IndexedDB value, Cache Storage response body, OPFS file, and web-storage value; compare the full inventory before import, after generation, and after reload

claim: Offers five frame rates, three trace styles, and an optional previous-frame overlay.
sandbox: demo; assert all rates and compare Canvas output after each style and overlay change

claim: Exports and imports settings as JSON and keeps imported settings after reload.
sandbox: real workspace; export changed settings, import them, and assert restored controls before and after reload

claim: Works offline after the first visit.
sandbox: fresh demo visit; wait for the controlling service worker, disable network, reload, and assert all sample frames
fresh demo; validate manifest display, icons, start URL, and controlling service worker

claim: The free version exports PNGs at 960 px.
sandbox: no license; use a 320 px local video; download the PNG pack and inspect the first PNG header for 960 px width

claim: Studio adds 1920 px, original-video-width exports, and six-column PDF trace sheets.
sandbox: valid cached license; use a 320 px local video; inspect PNG headers at 1920 and original width, then independently decode the six-cell first PDF row

claim: Studio costs USD 9 once and opens Flipbook Trace Studio in Dodo's hosted checkout.
sandbox: follow the registered checkout redirect; assert the Dodo session, product name, USD $9.00 total, One-time text, and the plain checkout disclosure in every published purchase surface

claim: A pasted Studio license is sent to Sociobot only to verify that license.
sandbox: after the shell settles, record every request during the explicit verification action; paste a token; assert exactly one GET to Sociobot's verification URL, no body, and no token in any other URL, header, or body

claim: Valid, invalid, and revoked Studio verdicts are cached for 24 hours and restored on reload without another request.
sandbox: verify an invalid token, reload, and assert one total request plus the persistent notice; restore a fresh valid verdict without a request; refresh a 24-hour-old valid verdict to revoked, reload, and assert one total request plus the persistent revoked notice and locked controls

claim: Clearing this site's browser data removes settings and a saved license.
sandbox: seed changed settings and a license; clear all browser data through the protocol; reload and assert defaults and no license

claim: The installed app checks this site for updates.
sandbox: serve a changed worker; request an update; assert a new shell cache and the update-ready notice
